text:
Clara Nguyen: hi everyone 44b first day and a quick blocker 4a6 i get a 403 when opening the "Redwood Design System" Figma file. can someone add me? also not sure which Notion page is the canonical roadmap -- found two versions. lastly, is there a short guide to the research process (how to request participants / shadow studies)? thanks!
Diego Morales: welcome Clara!! Figma email? i'll add you to the design org and the shared files.
Clara Nguyen: clara.nguyen@redwood.ai thanks Diego
design-ops-bot: Hi Clara 44b Onboarding checklist: 1) Request Figma access 2) Join #product-sync + #design-ops 3) Read Product > Roadmap (canonical) 4) Review Research Playbook (Notion) 5) Ask for Maze/Lookback seats if needed. Checklist: https://notion.redwood.ai/s/onboarding-product
Priya Singh: added you to the Figma team and invited you to the design system file. roadmap: Notion > Product Workspace > Roadmaps > "Current Roadmap" is the single source of truth. we keep an archived snapshot page if you find older copies.
Clara Nguyen: invite received, can open the file now 389 thanks Priya. re research: is there a place with recent transcripts and a recruiting form i can use if i want to run a quick usability test?
Hana Park: hey Clara 44b Research Playbook is under Product > Research. It has templates (discussion guide, consent, synthesis notes) and the recruiting form link. design-ops triages recruitment requests on Thursdays; reach out to @design-ops for external panels.
Diego Morales: also FYI we post study summaries to #product-research and tag squads. if you want to shadow, ping me and i'll add you to the next session as an observer.
Clara Nguyen: super helpful 60a one more thing: i want to make a small tokens tweak in a feature file. who approves token publishes to production? don't want to accidentally break anything.
Priya Singh: token publishes are gated. small changes in a branch are fine but any publish to prod needs eng-platform signoff. tag @platform-team and @Priya Singh in the PR, update the tokens changelog, run the visual-diff job (we use Percy), and we do a quick 15m review. tokens doc: https://notion.redwood.ai/s/tokens-playbook
Hana Park: we also have weekly token syncs on Fridays at 11am for larger changes. if it's a rename or breaking change, open a ticket in the design-system repo and schedule the review.
Clara Nguyen: perfect, thanks. who should I ask for Maze and Lookback seats and where's the research calendar?
design-ops-bot: Maze seat requests: https://forms.redwood.ai/maze-request (design-ops will approve). Lookback access: request via Product > Research Playbook. Research sessions calendar is shared as "Product Research" in GCal; request view/invite from design-ops.
Diego Morales: i'll assign you a buddy (Hana), and add you to the Tuesday design pairing session. great to have you on the team 680
Clara Nguyen: thank you all 60a i'll go through the checklist and ping if anything else is blocked. excited to jump in!
